# Feature Map

<!-- Generated by `npm run --silent control -- map --write` from app/routes.ts
and tools/feature-notes.ts. Do not edit by hand; CI checks this through
`npm test`. -->

Every route in `app/routes.ts`, with how to seed and reach it from the
control environment (`npm run --silent control -- dev`). Commands are
`control-mediarss` subcommands. **High** routes always need Kent.

## Admin pages

| Route | Pattern | Methods | What | Seed | Reach | High |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `root` | `/` | ANY | Redirects to /admin | - | `request GET / --status 302` |  |
| `admin` | `/admin` | ANY | Dashboard: feed list | - | `browse --path /admin --wait-for "Your Feeds"` |  |
| `adminFeedNew` | `/admin/feeds/new` | ANY | Create a directory or curated feed | - | `browse --path /admin/feeds/new --record` |  |
| `adminFeedEdit` | `/admin/feeds/:id/edit` | ANY | Edit feed settings | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` creates a curated feed with fixture audio and prints its id and token | `browse --path /admin/feeds/<id>/edit --record` |  |
| `adminFeed` | `/admin/feeds/:id` | ANY | Feed details: items, tokens, analytics, artwork | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` creates a curated feed with fixture audio and prints its id and token | `browse --path /admin/feeds/<id> --record` |  |
| `adminMedia` | `/admin/media` | ANY | Media library with search and sort (URL-synced) | - | `browse --path "/admin/media?sort=title-az" --wait-for "Media Library"` |  |
| `adminMediaEdit` | `/admin/media/*path/edit` | ANY | Edit a media file’s metadata (writes the file via ffmpeg) | Fixture media is copied into data/control/<port>/media, so edits never touch test/fixtures | `browse --path /admin/media/audio/Inkheart.m4b/edit --record` |  |
| `adminMediaDetail` | `/admin/media/*path` | ANY | Media details: metadata, feed assignments, analytics | - | `browse --path /admin/media/audio/Inkheart.m4b --record` |  |
| `adminVersion` | `/admin/version` | ANY | Version page | - | `browse --path /admin/version` |  |
| `adminCatchAll` | `/admin/*path` | ANY | Admin shell for unknown paths (200; the not-found UI renders in the page) | - | `browse --path /admin/does-not-exist` |  |

## Admin API

| Route | Pattern | Methods | What | Seed | Reach | High |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `adminApiVersion` | `/admin/api/version` | ANY | Version and commit info | - | `request GET /admin/api/version --contains commit` |  |
| `adminApiFeeds` | `/admin/api/feeds` | GET | List all feeds | - | `request GET /admin/api/feeds --contains "["` |  |
| `adminApiDirectories` | `/admin/api/directories` | GET | List media roots | - | `request GET /admin/api/directories --contains audio` |  |
| `adminApiBrowse` | `/admin/api/browse` | GET | Browse a media root directory | - | `request GET "/admin/api/browse?root=audio&path=" --contains Inkheart` |  |
| `adminApiCreateDirectoryFeed` | `/admin/api/feeds/directory` | POST | Create a directory feed | - | `request POST /admin/api/feeds/directory --json-body '{"name":"Audio","directoryPaths":["audio:"]}' --status 201` |  |
| `adminApiCreateCuratedFeed` | `/admin/api/feeds/curated` | POST | Create a curated feed (also creates its first token) | - | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` |  |
| `adminApiFeedAnalytics` | `/admin/api/feeds/:id/analytics` | GET | Feed analytics for a time window | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` creates a curated feed with fixture audio and prints its id and token | `request GET "/admin/api/feeds/<id>/analytics?days=30"` |  |
| `adminApiFeed` | `/admin/api/feeds/:id` | GET, PUT, DELETE | Get, update, or delete a feed | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` creates a curated feed with fixture audio and prints its id and token | `request GET /admin/api/feeds/<id> --contains tokens` |  |
| `adminApiFeedTokens` | `/admin/api/feeds/:id/tokens` | POST | Create a feed access token | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` creates a curated feed with fixture audio and prints its id and token | `request POST /admin/api/feeds/<id>/tokens --json-body '{"label":"test"}'` | yes |
| `adminApiFeedItems` | `/admin/api/feeds/:id/items` | POST, DELETE, PATCH | Add, remove, or reorder curated feed items | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` creates a curated feed with fixture audio and prints its id and token | `request POST /admin/api/feeds/<id>/items --json-body '{"items":["video:Toy Story.mkv"]}'` |  |
| `adminApiFeedArtwork` | `/admin/api/feeds/:id/artwork` | GET, POST, DELETE | Get, upload, or delete feed artwork (writes data/artwork) | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` creates a curated feed with fixture audio and prints its id and token | `request GET /admin/api/feeds/<id>/artwork` |  |
| `adminApiToken` | `/admin/api/tokens/:token` | DELETE | Revoke a feed token | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` creates a curated feed with fixture audio and prints its id and token | `request DELETE /admin/api/tokens/<token>` | yes |
| `adminApiMediaAnalytics` | `/admin/api/media-analytics/*path` | GET | Analytics for one media file across feeds | - | `request GET /admin/api/media-analytics/audio/Inkheart.m4b` |  |
| `adminApiMedia` | `/admin/api/media` | GET | List all media with metadata | - | `request GET /admin/api/media --contains Inkheart` |  |
| `adminApiMediaAssignments` | `/admin/api/media/assignments` | GET, PUT, POST | Read or change which feeds a media file belongs to | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` creates a curated feed with fixture audio and prints its id and token | `request GET /admin/api/media/assignments` |  |
| `adminApiMediaDetail` | `/admin/api/media/*path` | GET | One media file’s metadata and assignments | - | `request GET /admin/api/media/audio/Inkheart.m4b --contains Inkheart` |  |
| `adminApiMediaMetadata` | `/admin/api/media/*path/metadata` | PUT | Write metadata tags into a media file (ffmpeg) | Writes the copy under data/control/<port>/media; run dev --fresh to reset | `request PUT /admin/api/media/audio/Inkheart.m4b/metadata --json-body '{"title":"Inkheart"}'` |  |
| `adminApiMediaStream` | `/admin/api/media-stream/*path` | GET | Stream media for the admin player (no token) | - | `request GET /admin/api/media-stream/audio/Inkheart.m4b --status 200` |  |
| `adminApiMediaUpload` | `/admin/api/media/upload` | POST | Upload a media file into a writable media root | Uploads land in data/control/<port>/media; run dev --fresh to reset | `browse --path /admin/media --record (upload UI)` |  |
| `adminApiArtwork` | `/admin/api/artwork/*path` | GET | Embedded artwork for a media file | - | `request GET /admin/api/artwork/audio/Inkheart.m4b` |  |

## Public feed, media, and art (podcast apps)

| Route | Pattern | Methods | What | Seed | Reach | High |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `feed` | `/feed/:token` | GET | RSS XML for a feed token; podcast apps subscribe to this URL | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` creates a curated feed with fixture audio and prints its id and token | `request GET /feed/<token> --contains "<rss"` | yes |
| `media` | `/media/:token/*path` | GET | Streams a media file (range requests) for a feed token | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` creates a curated feed with fixture audio and prints its id and token | `request GET /media/<token>/audio/Inkheart.m4b --status 200` | yes |
| `art` | `/art/:token/*path` | GET | Feed or item artwork for a feed token | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` creates a curated feed with fixture audio and prints its id and token | `request GET /art/<token>/audio/Inkheart.m4b --status 200` | yes |

## OAuth

| Route | Pattern | Methods | What | Seed | Reach | High |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `oauthServerMetadata` | `/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server` | ANY | OAuth authorization server metadata for MCP clients | - | `request GET /.well-known/oauth-authorization-server --contains token_endpoint` | yes |
| `mcpProtectedResource` | `/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp` | ANY | OAuth protected resource metadata for /mcp | - | `request GET /.well-known/oauth-protected-resource/mcp --contains authorization_servers` | yes |
| `oauthToken` | `/oauth/token` | POST | Token endpoint (authorization code + PKCE, refresh) | Needs a code from POST /admin/authorize; covered by app/routes/oauth tests | `request POST /oauth/token --status 400 (no body)` | yes |
| `oauthJwks` | `/oauth/jwks` | GET | Public signing keys | - | `request GET /oauth/jwks --contains keys` | yes |
| `oauthRegister` | `/oauth/register` | POST | Dynamic client registration | - | `request POST /oauth/register --json-body '{}' --status 400` | yes |
| `adminAuthorize` | `/admin/authorize` | GET, POST | OAuth consent page (GET) and approval (POST) for MCP clients | Needs client_id, redirect_uri, code_challenge query params from a registered client | `browse --path "/admin/authorize?client_id=..." --record` | yes |

## MCP

| Route | Pattern | Methods | What | Seed | Reach | High |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mcp` | `/mcp` | GET, POST, OPTIONS | MCP server (streamable HTTP); requires an OAuth bearer token | - | `request POST /mcp --status 401 (no token)` | yes |
| `mcpWidget` | `/mcp/widget/:token/*path` | GET | MCP UI widget media for a feed token | `execute --code-file tools/control-fixtures/curated-feed.ts` creates a curated feed with fixture audio and prints its id and token | `request GET /mcp/widget/<token>/audio/Inkheart.m4b` | yes |

## Operations

| Route | Pattern | Methods | What | Seed | Reach | High |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `health` | `/health` | GET | Public health snapshot: status, version, commit SHA, database, media roots, MCP, OAuth | - | `health (or request GET /health --contains '"status":"ok"')` |  |
| `adminHealth` | `/admin/health` | GET | Admin health snapshot (same data as /health) | - | `request GET /admin/health --contains status` |  |
